items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Gene Krupa in relation to Charlie Parker ('Bird') and Gus Johnson, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of meeting Krupa.

ctx.x: See that's the thing that always and the minute we start talking about that, we as black musicians then we suddenly - it's Crow Jim, you know or something like that. We're bad guys that we've got a chip on our shoulder.
Well, maybe we have. You know maybe we've got a chip...Shit if you look at it man, if it weren't for R y Eldridge, where would Gene Krupa be?
